Record Class AdocLibrary

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.plugin.adoc.AdocLibrary
Record Components:
coordinates - the library's coordinates
zip - the resolved adoc zip, or null for a reactor member
sourceRoot - the reactor member's src/docs/asciidoc, or null for a zip
public record AdocLibrary(AdocCoordinates coordinates, Path zip, Path sourceRoot) extends Record
One library to put in the union: either an external zip resolved from a repository, or a module of the same reactor whose AsciiDoc source root is on this machine. Exactly one of zip() and sourceRoot() is set.
